observations.note: Step 8 asks for the completed marks in one edit of the plan, but the session made seven separate edits, one per row.

The session tried to edit a test file with a shell `sed -i` even though the prompt says to use file tools and the shell allows only declared commands, so it was denied and the edit was redone with Edit.
Five separate small edits hit the same spot in filing.py, which could have been fewer and larger edits.

conformance.item: Write tests first and see them fail before changing source
Write the completed marks in one edit of the plan
Use only declared shell commands and file tools for edits
Run only the test files the phase's rows name, not the whole suite
Check specs touched by the changed source files that the plan does not name
Report deviations in the phase note
